facts.fact: The BCEAO set 30 September 2026 as the latest date for banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions of the WAEMU to connect to the PI-SPI instant payment platform, and 30 June 2027 for microfinance institutions; the decision date is not given, so the article's published date is used.

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions, microfinance institutions
